title: Overwatch Retail Patch Notes – April 18, 2019
raw_text: April 18, 2019 Overwatch Retail Patch Notes – April 18, 2019 A new patch is now live on Windows PC. Read below to learn more about the latest changes. To share your feedback, please post in the General Discussion forum For a list of known issues, visit our Bug Report forum. For troubleshooting assistance, visit our Technical Support forum. BUG FIXES Heroes Genji Fixed a rare bug where Genji couldn’t use any of his abilities until he reloaded or used his melee attack
